references.text: The burnt offering was to be a bull from the cattle, without defect, as mentioned here with a young bull
A ram is mentioned as a burnt offering from the small livestock, corresponding to the ram brought here
A one-year-old lamb is used for a burnt offering, the same age as the lamb mentioned in this verse
A one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering, parallel to the one-year-old lamb here
One-year-old lambs are used for the daily burnt offering, with the same age requirement as here
One-year-old lambs without defect for a burnt offering, the same type of sacrifice described here
A young bull, a ram, and one-year-old lambs for a burnt offering, the same combination of animals
